Limits.description: recovery_bytes is the configured per-element package byte retention limit; default 67108864, maximum 268435456, zero disables retention. It is not a memory measurement.

ModelBytesNotRetainedDetails.description: JSON Schema enforces positive model_bytes and the 268435456 maximum for each count. Rust validation enforces retained_bytes <= limit_bytes and the reason-dependent checked sum: budget_exceeded requires retained_bytes + model_bytes > limit_bytes; allocation_failed requires the sum to fit.
